messages:
Jordan: quick heads-up  the code example on /guides/optimize/cache-keys embeds a GitHub Gist that now returns 403 (looks like the gist was made private during a repo migration). the page shows an empty embed box.
Hazel: thanks. which gist id / URL is it? can you paste the href?
Jordan: it's https://gist.github.com/redwood-example/9a8b7c6d5e4 — clicking in staging yields 403. noticed in a user bug report.
Docs-bot: link-scan: detected external embed 403 in /guides/optimize/cache-keys (staging). filed DOCS-4271.
Milos: we migrated a few example gists to the new org last week; some were set to private by accident. ops is fixing gist visibility but that might be slow.
Jordan: thinking quick remediation: replace the embed with an inline fenced code block snapshot (copy gist content into the docs) and add a small caption + link to the new gist URL. less fragile long-term.
Hazel: I can make that PR. I'll include both the inline snippet and a follow-up TODO comment linking to the new public gist so we can re-enable live embeds later if desired.
Jordan: perfect. include a one-line frontmatter changelog so it's visible in release notes. also add a tiny preview assertion that the page contains the code fence (so embeds don't get stripped).
Hazel: opened PR: https://git.internal.redwood.io/docs/pr/9402  what I changed:
```bash
git checkout -b docs/fix/gist-to-inline
# paste gist content into content/guides/optimize/cache-keys.md as a fenced block
# add a short caption and link to the new gist
sed -i "1,1s/^/---\nchangelog: replace private gist with inline snippet\n---\n/" content/guides/optimize/cache-keys.md
git commit -am "docs: inline gist to avoid 403 on embed"
git push origin docs/fix/gist-to-inline
```
Milos: quick review  small nit: wrap the code fence language tag with "bash" for clarity and add a one-line alt-note pointing to the gist migration ticket. otherwise looks good.
Hazel: updated PR with language tag and migration note. added Review-bot check that asserts the inline snippet exists in preview.
Review-bot: automated checks passed. preview shows inline snippet rendering.
Jordan: quick manual check  looks good on staging. thank you.
Milos: approving now. merging once CI completes.
Docs-bot: PR 9402 merged to main by Milos. DOCS-4271 marked resolved. staging preview rebuilt.
Hazel: confirmed on staging: page shows inline snippet and the old embed placeholder is gone. filing a small follow-up to re-enable embeds after gist visibility is fixed. closing DOCS-4271. :white_check_mark:
